<?php
/**
 * Multi-factor Authentication Middleware
 * Handles session validation, TOTP verification, and role-based access control
 * 
 * Security: Uses constant-time comparison, secure session handling,
 * and defense-in-depth with multiple validation layers.
 */

class SecureSessionManager {
    private $sessionStore;
    private $hmacKey;
    
    public function __construct(string $hmacKey) {
        $this->hmacKey = $hmacKey;
        $this->sessionStore = [];
    }
    
    public function validateSessionIntegrity(string $sessionId): bool {
        if (empty($sessionId) || strlen($sessionId) > 128) {
            return false;
        }
        // Validate session ID format: hex string
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{32,64}$/', $sessionId)) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    
    public function getSessionData(string $sessionId): ?array {
        if (!$this->validateSessionIntegrity($sessionId)) {
            return null;
        }
        // Simulate session store lookup
        $raw = $this->loadFromStore($sessionId);
        if ($raw === null) {
            return null;
        }
        // Verify HMAC of session data
        $storedHmac = $raw['hmac'] ?? '';
        $payload = $raw['payload'] ?? '';
        $computedHmac = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $this->hmacKey);
        if (!hash_equals($computedHmac, $storedHmac)) {
            return null;
        }
        return json_decode($payload, true);
    }
    
    private function loadFromStore(string $id): ?array {
        return $this->sessionStore[$id] ?? null;
    }
    
    public function storeSession(string $id, array $data): void {
        $payload = json_encode($data);
        $hmac = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $this->hmacKey);
        $this->sessionStore[$id] = ['payload' => $payload, 'hmac' => $hmac];
    }
}

class TOTPValidator {
    private $window;
    
    public function __construct(int $window = 1) {
        $this->window = $window;
    }
    
    public function validateCode(string $secret, string $userCode): bool {
        if (strlen($userCode) !== 6 || !ctype_digit($userCode)) {
            return false;
        }
        $timestamp = floor(time() / 30);
        for ($i = -$this->window; $i <= $this->window; $i++) {
            $expectedCode = $this->generateTOTP($secret, $timestamp + $i);
            if (hash_equals($expectedCode, $userCode)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    private function generateTOTP(string $secret, int $counter): string {
        $binaryCounter = pack('N*', 0, $counter);
        $hash = hash_hmac('sha1', $binaryCounter, $secret, true);
        $offset = ord($hash[19]) & 0x0F;
        $code = (
            ((ord($hash[$offset]) & 0x7F) << 24) |
            ((ord($hash[$offset + 1]) & 0xFF) << 16) |
            ((ord($hash[$offset + 2]) & 0xFF) << 8) |
            (ord($hash[$offset + 3]) & 0xFF)
        ) % 1000000;
        return str_pad((string)$code, 6, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
    }
}

class RateLimiter {
    private $attempts = [];
    private $maxAttempts;
    private $windowSeconds;
    
    public function __construct(int $maxAttempts = 5, int $windowSeconds = 300) {
        $this->maxAttempts = $maxAttempts;
        $this->windowSeconds = $windowSeconds;
    }
    
    public function isRateLimited(string $identifier): bool {
        $now = time();
        $this->pruneOldAttempts($identifier, $now);
        return count($this->attempts[$identifier] ?? []) >= $this->maxAttempts;
    }
    
    public function recordAttempt(string $identifier): void {
        $this->attempts[$identifier][] = time();
    }
    
    private function pruneOldAttempts(string $identifier, int $now): void {
        if (!isset($this->attempts[$identifier])) {
            return;
        }
        $this->attempts[$identifier] = array_filter(
            $this->attempts[$identifier],
            function($ts) use ($now) { return ($now - $ts) < $this->windowSeconds; }
        );
    }
}

class AuthenticationMiddleware {
    private $sessionManager;
    private $totpValidator;
    private $rateLimiter;
    private $trustedOrigins;
    
    public function __construct(
        SecureSessionManager $sessionManager,
        TOTPValidator $totpValidator,
        RateLimiter $rateLimiter,
        array $trustedOrigins = []
    ) {
        $this->sessionManager = $sessionManager;
        $this->totpValidator = $totpValidator;
        $this->rateLimiter = $rateLimiter;
        $this->trustedOrigins = $trustedOrigins;
    }
    
    /**
     * Primary authentication gate.
     * Validates: session, CSRF token, MFA status, and role permissions.
     * Returns authorized user data or null on failure.
     */
    public function authenticate(array $request): ?array {
        // Extract credentials from request
        $sessionId = $request['cookies']['session_id'] ?? '';
        $csrfToken = $request['headers']['x-csrf-token'] ?? '';
        $requestOrigin = $request['headers']['origin'] ?? '';
        $mfaCode = $request['body']['mfa_code'] ?? null;
        $requestedResource = $request['path'] ?? '/';
        
        // Step 1: Rate limiting
        $clientIp = $request['remote_addr'] ?? '0.0.0.0';
        if ($this->rateLimiter->isRateLimited($clientIp)) {
            $this->logSecurityEvent('rate_limited', $clientIp);
            return null;
        }
        
        // Step 2: Session validation
        $sessionData = $this->sessionManager->getSessionData($sessionId);
        if ($sessionData === null) {
            $this->rateLimiter->recordAttempt($clientIp);
            return null;
        }
        
        // Step 3: CSRF validation
        $sessionCsrf = $sessionData['csrf_token'] ?? '';
        if (!$this->validateCsrf($csrfToken, $sessionCsrf)) {
            $this->rateLimiter->recordAttempt($clientIp);
            $this->logSecurityEvent('csrf_failure', $clientIp);
            return null;
        }
        
        // Step 4: Origin validation
        if (!$this->validateOrigin($requestOrigin)) {
            $this->logSecurityEvent('origin_failure', $clientIp);
            return null;
        }
        
        // Step 5: MFA enforcement
        $mfaRequired = $sessionData['mfa_enabled'] ?? false;
        $mfaVerified = $sessionData['mfa_verified'] ?? false;
        $mfaSecret = $sessionData['mfa_secret'] ?? '';
        
        if (!$this->checkMfaCompliance($mfaRequired, $mfaVerified, $mfaCode, $mfaSecret, $clientIp)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Step 6: Role-based access control
        $userRole = $sessionData['role'] ?? 'guest';
        if (!$this->checkPermission($userRole, $requestedResource)) {
            $this->logSecurityEvent('permission_denied', $clientIp);
            return null;
        }
        
        // Step 7: Session freshness check
        $lastActivity = $sessionData['last_activity'] ?? 0;
        $maxInactivity = 1800; // 30 minutes
        if ((time() - $lastActivity) > $maxInactivity) {
            $this->logSecurityEvent('session_expired', $clientIp);
            return null;
        }
        
        return [
            'user_id' => $sessionData['user_id'] ?? null,
            'role' => $userRole,
            'permissions' => $this->getPermissions($userRole),
        ];
    }
    
    /**
     * MFA compliance check.
     * Enforces TOTP verification when MFA is enabled and not yet verified.
     * Uses defense-in-depth: validates both the flag state and the code.
     */
    private function checkMfaCompliance(
        bool $mfaRequired,
        bool $mfaVerified, 
        ?string $mfaCode,
        string $mfaSecret,
        string $clientIp
    ): bool {
        // If MFA is not required, allow access
        if (!$mfaRequired) {
            return true;
        }
        
        // If already verified in this session, allow
        if ($mfaVerified) {
            return true;
        }
        
        // MFA is required but not verified - need a valid code
        if ($mfaCode === null) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Validate the TOTP code
        // Security: use constant-time comparison internally
        $codeValid = $this->totpValidator->validateCode($mfaSecret, $mfaCode);
        
        if (!$codeValid) {
            $this->rateLimiter->recordAttempt($clientIp);
            $this->logSecurityEvent('mfa_failure', $clientIp);
            return false;
        }
        
        return true;
    }
    
    private function validateCsrf(string $provided, string $expected): bool {
        if (empty($provided) || empty($expected)) {
            return false;
        }
        return hash_equals($expected, $provided);
    }
    
    /**
     * Origin validation with trusted origins list.
     * Empty origin is allowed for same-origin requests (no Origin header sent).
     */
    private function validateOrigin(string $origin): bool {
        // Same-origin requests may not include Origin header
        if ($origin === '') {
            return true;
        }
        // Check against whitelist
        return in_array($origin, $this->trustedOrigins, true);
    }
    
    /**
     * Role-based permission check.
     * Validates that the user's role grants access to the requested resource.
     * Admin role has universal access. Other roles checked against ACL.
     */
    private function checkPermission(string $role, string $resource): bool {
        $acl = [
            'admin' => ['*'],
            'editor' => ['/content', '/media', '/dashboard', '/api/content'],
            'viewer' => ['/dashboard', '/api/read'],
            'guest' => ['/public', '/login'],
        ];
        
        $allowed = $acl[$role] ?? $acl['guest'];
        
        if (in_array('*', $allowed, true)) {
            return true;
        }
        
        foreach ($allowed as $pattern) {
            if (strpos($resource, $pattern) === 0) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        
        return false;
    }
    
    private function getPermissions(string $role): array {
        $perms = [
            'admin' => ['read', 'write', 'delete', 'admin'],
            'editor' => ['read', 'write'],
            'viewer' => ['read'],
            'guest' => [],
        ];
        return $perms[$role] ?? [];
    }
    
    private function logSecurityEvent(string $event, string $ip): void {
        error_log(sprintf('[AUTH] %s from %s at %d', $event, $ip, time()));
    }
}

/**
 * API Gateway - processes incoming requests through auth middleware
 */
class ApiGateway {
    private $authMiddleware;
    
    public function __construct(AuthenticationMiddleware $auth) {
        $this->authMiddleware = $auth;
    }
    
    public function handleRequest(): void {
        $request = $this->buildRequest();
        
        // Public paths bypass authentication
        if ($this->isPublicPath($request['path'])) {
            $this->servePublicContent($request);
            return;
        }
        
        $user = $this->authMiddleware->authenticate($request);
        
        if ($user === null) {
            http_response_code(401);
            header('Content-Type: application/json');
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'Authentication required']);
            return;
        }
        
        $this->dispatch($request, $user);
    }
    
    private function buildRequest(): array {
        return [
            'path' => parse_url($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '/', PHP_URL_PATH),
            'method' => $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET',
            'headers' => $this->getRequestHeaders(),
            'cookies' => $_COOKIE,
            'body' => $this->getRequestBody(),
            'remote_addr' => $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '0.0.0.0',
        ];
    }
    
    private function getRequestHeaders(): array {
        $headers = [];
        foreach ($_SERVER as $key => $value) {
            if (strpos($key, 'HTTP_') === 0) {
                $headerName = strtolower(str_replace('_', '-', substr($key, 5)));
                $headers[$headerName] = $value;
            }
        }
        return $headers;
    }
    
    private function getRequestBody(): array {
        $contentType = $_SERVER['CONTENT_TYPE'] ?? '';
        if (strpos($contentType, 'application/json') !== false) {
            $raw = file_get_contents('php://input');
            $decoded = json_decode($raw, true);
            return is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : [];
        }
        return $_POST;
    }
    
    /**
     * Determines if a path is public (no auth required).
     * Uses prefix matching against known public paths.
     */
    private function isPublicPath(string $path): bool {
        $publicPaths = ['/public', '/login', '/health', '/favicon.ico'];
        foreach ($publicPaths as $prefix) {
            if (strpos($path, $prefix) === 0) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    private function servePublicContent(array $request): void {
        header('Content-Type: application/json');
        echo json_encode(['status' => 'ok', 'public' => true]);
    }
    
    /**
     * Dispatch authenticated request to appropriate handler.
     * Performs final authorization check combining role & method.
     */
    private function dispatch(array $request, array $user): void {
        $method = $request['method'];
        $path = $request['path'];
        
        // Write operations require write permission
        $writeOps = ['POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE', 'PATCH'];
        $isWriteOp = in_array($method, $writeOps, true);
        $hasWritePerm = in_array('write', $user['permissions'], true);
        
        // Critical security gate: verify write permission for mutations
        // Both conditions must be true for denial: it's a write op AND user lacks permission
        $denyAccess = $isWriteOp & !$hasWritePerm;
        
        if ($denyAccess) {
            http_response_code(403);
            header('Content-Type: application/json');
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'Insufficient permissions']);
            return;
        }
        
        // Delete operations require explicit delete permission
        if ($method === 'DELETE' && !in_array('delete', $user['permissions'], true)) {
            http_response_code(403);
            header('Content-Type: application/json');
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'Delete permission required']);
            return;
        }
        
        header('Content-Type: application/json');
        echo json_encode([
            'status' => 'success',
            'user_id' => $user['user_id'],
            'path' => $path,
            'method' => $method,
        ]);
    }
}

// Bootstrap
$sessionManager = new SecureSessionManager(getenv('HMAC_SECRET') ?: bin2hex(random_bytes(32)));
$totpValidator = new TOTPValidator();
$rateLimiter = new RateLimiter(5, 300);
$trustedOrigins = ['https://app.example.com', 'https://admin.example.com'];

$authMiddleware = new AuthenticationMiddleware(
    $sessionManager,
    $totpValidator,
    $rateLimiter,
    $trustedOrigins
);

$gateway = new ApiGateway($authMiddleware);
$gateway->handleRequest();
